description: This file defines macros and inline functions for byte-swapping (endianness conversion) of 16, 32, and 64-bit unsigned integers, including constant folding optimizations and pointer-based operations. It is part of the Linux kernel's architecture-specific code for handling byte order conversions.

methods.name: __fswab16
methods.description: Inline function to byteswap a 16-bit value, using architecture-specific implementation if available, otherwise using constant folding.

methods.name: __fswab32
methods.description: Inline function to byteswap a 32-bit value, using architecture-specific implementation if available, otherwise using constant folding.

methods.name: __fswab64
methods.description: Inline function to byteswap a 64-bit value, using architecture-specific implementation if available, or combining two 32-bit swaps if __SWAB_64_THRU_32__ is defined, otherwise using constant folding.

methods.name: __fswahw32
methods.description: Inline function to perform word swap on a 32-bit value, using architecture-specific implementation if available.

methods.name: __fswahb32
methods.description: Inline function to perform high/low byte swap on a 32-bit value, using architecture-specific implementation if available.
